capabilities: Render a masonry image gallery from images selected by Base filters
Configure layout, columns, row height, gutter and corner radius from the Base view config
Open images in a lightbox viewer and exit back to the gallery
Update the gallery live as matching images are added or removed
extras: Warns that galleries of many large (e.g. 4K) photos can slow the app; vertical masonry ordering is approximate because it uses CSS columns; beta releases are available via BRAT; only local vault images are supported (no remote images, no EXIF dates yet).
intentEvidence: This is based off the work by Luca Orio — Obsidian Image Gallery — but updated for the Obsidian Bases plugin.
problem: Obsidian Bases has no built-in view for displaying images, and building galleries in notes normally requires manual embeds or code blocks.

relations.evidence: Code based on the original work by Luca Orio.
but updated for the Obsidian Bases plugin

summary: Zero-setup masonry image gallery view for Obsidian Bases that renders vault images selected by Base filters.
